crossRefs.note: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.
He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.
For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will…
Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

parallels.note: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.

translations.web: He made darkness a shelter around himself: gathering of waters, and thick clouds of the skies.
translations.bsb: He made darkness a canopy around Him, a gathering of water and thick clouds.
translations.kjv: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters, and thick clouds of the skies.
translations.asv: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, Gathering of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
